# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user. 

# Read in Data

mask cp6 used
markers = Ir191, Ir193, H3, CA9, SMA, panCK, CD8a, CD68

# Images, masks, panel

## Read in Data 
```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")

panel <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/panel.csv")

# Of note: the multi-channel images generated by steinbock are saved as 32-bit images while the segmentation masks are saved as 16-bit images. To correctly scale pixel values of the segmentation masks when reading them in, we will need to set as.is = TRUE.
masks <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/masks/", as.is = TRUE)
```

## set channelNames() 
```{r}
channelNames(images) <- panel$clean_target
```

## safety check
It is crucial that the order of the images in both CytoImageList objects is the same.
```{r}
all.equal(names(images), names(masks))
```


## Add additional metadata to the `elementMetadata` slot of the `CytoImageList` (accessible via mcols)
```{r}
# Read in images
images_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/images.csv",col_names = TRUE)
images_meta$names <- str_split(images_meta$image,".tiff",simplify = TRUE)[,1]
images_meta$TMA_id <- str_split(images_meta$acquisition_description," ",simplify = TRUE)[,1]


# Add information to metadata of CytoImageList
mcols(images)$sample_id <- images_meta$names[match(names(images),images_meta$names)] # sample_id is set to image name
mcols(images)$TMA_id <- images_meta$TMA_id[match(names(images),images_meta$names)]


# Read in external metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(patient_meta$grid,"x",patient_meta$x,"y",patient_meta$y),"NA","")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "x","X")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "y","Y")
patient_meta[is.na(patient_meta$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data


# Add information to metadata of CytoImageList
mcols(images)$PID <- patient_meta$PID[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$type <- patient_meta$type[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]
mcols(images)$subtype <- patient_meta$subtype[match(mcols(images)$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]

images_meta$PID <- patient_meta$PID[match(images_meta$TMA_id,patient_meta$TMA_id)]

# Transfer to masks objects as well
mcols(masks) <- mcols(images)
```
## check artefact correction
```{r}

plotPixels(images[names(images)=="ZTMA224.2_BlockB_105"],
           mask = masks[names(masks)=="ZTMA224.2_BlockB_105"],
           img_id = "sample_id",
           colour_by = c("Vim", "CA9", "SMA", "panCK", "CD8a"),
           colour = list("Vim" = c("black","magenta"),
                         "CA9" = c("black", "darkblue"),
                         "SMA" = c("black", "yellow"),
                         "panCK" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "CD8a" = c("black", "red")
                         ),
           thick = FALSE,
           image_title = NULL,
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7))


```


## Save

```{r}
saveRDS(images, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
saveRDS(masks, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
```



# Single Cell Experiment


## Read in steinbock output
```{r}
sce <- read_steinbock("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel",intensities_folder = "intensities",return_as = "sce",regionprops_folder = "regionprops", graphs_folder = "neighbors")

dim(assay(sce,"counts")) # 1623937 cells
```

## Set colnames() and rownames()
```{r}
colnames(sce) <- paste0(sce$sample_id, "_", sce$ObjectNumber) # unique identifiers per cell

rownames(sce) <- rowData(sce)$clean_target
```


## add metadata
```{r}
## 1. Add PID based on images
sce$PID <- images_meta$PID[match(sce$sample_id, images_meta$names)] 

## 2. Add all other metadata based on metadata file
meta_add <- colnames(patient_meta)[!colnames(patient_meta) %in% c("PID","grid","x","y","spot","no_tissue","sample_id")]

patient_meta <- as.data.frame(patient_meta)
              
for (entry in meta_add) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- patient_meta[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],patient_meta[,"PID"])]
}
```


```{r}
# Check whether every sample (and cell) is associated with a PID
colData(sce)%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  select(sample_id, PID, TMA_id)%>%
  unique()%>%
  filter(is.na(TMA_id), is.na(PID))

# ZTMA224.2_BlockA_129.tiff doesn't have PID and TMA_id
images_meta%>%
  select(image, PID, TMA_id)%>%
  filter(is.na(PID))

patient_meta%>%
  select(PID, TMA_id)%>%
  filter(is.na(TMA_id))
```

## transfer counts

Problem: Right-skewed distribution (bias from highly expressing cells)
Solution: Count transformation using an inverse hyperbolic sine function (arcsinh; common in flow cytometry) = leads to linear-like scale near zero and log-like scale beyond a threshold (`cofactor`)
We apply a `cofactor` of `1`.

```{r}
library(spatialEco)

# do winsoring quantoile before asinh normaliuation (99.9) (exprs_quant (with arcsinh) and quant (without))
assay(sce, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce)/1)
assay(sce, "quant") <- winsorize(counts(sce), p=c(0,0.999))
assay(sce, "exprs_quant") <- asinh(winsorize(counts(sce), p=c(0,0.999))/1)

# check
dittoRidgePlot(sce[, 1:10000], var = "CA9", group.by = "type", assay = "counts") +   # group_by = 'patient_id'
    ggtitle("CA9 - before transformation")

dittoRidgePlot(sce[, 1:10000], var = "CA9", group.by = "type", assay = "quant") +
    ggtitle("CA9 - before transformation (winsorized)")

dittoRidgePlot(sce[, 1:10000], var = "CA9", group.by = "type", assay = "exprs") +
    ggtitle("CA9 - after transformation")

dittoRidgePlot(sce[, 1:10000], var = "CA9", group.by = "type", assay = "exprs_quant") +
    ggtitle("CA9 - after transformation (winsorized)")

```

## Define use_channels
```{r}
rowData(sce)$use_channel <- !grepl("Ir191|Ir193|H3|Xe131|Xe134|Ba138", rowData(sce)$clean_target)

# check
rowData(sce)$clean_target[rowData(sce)$use_channel=="FALSE"] # check which chaannel == "FALSE"
```

## add cell_id to colData
```{r}
colData(sce)$cell_id <- colnames(sce)
```

## Save
```{r}
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_01.rds")
```
